Synopsis:
    Race report from the first two free practice sessions at the new Madrid Madring circuit for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix. Mercedes dominates with Antonelli (FP2 fastest) and Russell (FP1 fastest). Ferrari's Leclerc and Hamilton are close behind. Championship leader Antonelli holds a 66-point lead over Russell. Notable incidents include Racing Bulls rookie Lindblad's red-flag crash and Norris missing FP2 for a gearbox change.
